heading: Allotments
lead: The Secretary shall make allotments under this subchapter to eligible systems to establish and administer systems—

tree.text: which meet the requirements of section 10805 of this title; and

children.text: protect and advocate the rights of individuals with mental illness; and
investigate incidents of abuse and neglect of individuals with mental illness if the incidents are reported to the system or if there is probable cause to believe that the incidents occurred.

notes.text: Amendments1991—Par. (2). Pub. L. 102–173 substituted “individuals with mental illness” for “mentally ill individuals” in two places.

ancestors.heading: PROTECTION AND ADVOCACY FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH MENTAL ILLNESS
